problem_markdown: Let $(a_n)$ be a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers. Show that for each fixed $p$, infinitely many terms have a representation $a_m=xa_p+ya_q$ with positive integers $x,y$ and $q>p$.
solutions_markdown: One residue class modulo $a_p$ contains infinitely many terms. Choose a term $a_q$ in that class with $q>p$. Every later term $a_m$ in the same class satisfies $a_m-a_q=xa_p$ for some positive integer $x$. Taking $y=1$ gives the required representation for infinitely many $m$.
